headline: 5 Reasons My Local Political Party Finally Expelled Me After A Decade Of Attendance
body:
1. Bringing a personalized 'Vote for Mirza' branded bouncy castle to a somber, indoor policy drafting session.
2. Insisting that all party manifestos be translated exclusively into interpretative dance routines before public distribution.
3. Repeatedly attempting to pay my annual party membership dues in jars of antique, non-circulating postage stamps.
4. Refusing to applaud during a three-hour speech unless the speaker used a rhyming couplet for every single policy point.
5. Accidentally CC’ing the entire opposition party on a group chat where I was roleplaying as a disgruntled municipal lamp post.
caption: It’s been a rough week for local politics, but at least I’m finally off the group chat. Tag a friend who would be expelled for the exact same reasons. #PoliticalDrama #ExpulsionChronicles #LocalNews #PoliticsIndia (satire)
igHook: Tag someone who would get expelled from a political party for bringing a bouncy castle to a meeting.
imagePrompt: A person in a smart casual outfit standing outside a generic office building entrance, looking down at their phone while holding a large, brightly colored, deflated rubber toy. The scene is shot in a neutral, documentary style with a slightly blurred street background.

sourceHeadline.title: AIMIM Expels MLC Mirza Rahmath Baig with Immediate Effect

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 2 distinguishes itself by introducing truly absurd, visual scenarios (a bouncy castle, interpretative dance, roleplaying as a lamp post) that break away from the repetitive 'WhatsApp group emoji' tropes found in the other candidates. It manages to be both structurally sound and genuinely funny without relying on formulaic institutional cynicism.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The article uses the name 'Mirza' in a generic, non-specific way as part of a clearly fictional, absurd anecdote. None of the listed reasons for expulsion involve real public figures, specific political parties, or harmful content that violates the safety guidelines.
